newsitem.title: POLAND: BWR mulls new issue for strategic investor.
newsitem.headline: BWR mulls new issue for strategic investor.

text.p: The small Polish Bank Wspolpracy Regionalnej SA (BWR) plans a new share issue this year, which may be directed to a strategic investor, the bank's president said on Thursday.
"The bank plans to carry out a new share issue in 1997, possibly to a strategic investor," Jan Blajer told a news briefing, adding it was too early to give more details.

Blajer said he forecast BWR's net profit to be higher in 1997 than last year in real terms. BWR netted 4.4 million zlotys in the first 11 months of 1996, up from 3.1 million zlotys in the same period of 1995.
The bank, based in the southern city of Krakow, also plans to open branches in the cities of Warsaw, Lublin and Tarnow as well as to further develop its current networks in southern Poland, he added.
